1502. Unique Paths in Grid

50

Medium

Problem Statement:
You are given an m x n grid. Your task is to find the number of unique paths from the top-left corner (cell (1,1)) to the bottom-right corner (cell (m,n)). At any point, you can only move either right or down.
input_spec: The first line contains two integers m and n, representing the number of rows and columns in the grid.
output_spec: Print a single integer, the number of unique paths from the top-left to the bottom-right corner.
